name: year
description: Reference year of the estimate, at 30 June

name: geography_level
description: Geographic level of the row, either state or australia
observations: australia marks the national aggregate, which is not a state and therefore carries a null state_id; state marks one of the eight states and territories

name: state_id
description: Code of the Australian state or territory
observations: Null on national (australia) rows, which are not a state

name: region_name
description: Name of the state, territory or national aggregate as published by the ABS

name: sex
observations: Male, Female or Persons, where Persons is the ABS-published total

name: age
description: Single year of age of the population counted
observations: Single years 0 to 99 plus the open-ended group 100 and over; stored as a string because the top group is not a number

name: series_id
description: ABS series identifier of the observation
observations: Foreign key to the au_abs_population series table
